data.cultural_impact: The name Shukr holds a profound cultural significance in the Islamic community, symbolizing a sense of gratitude and appreciation towards Allah SWT (God) for His blessings and favors. This name carries a deep emotional connection and is considered a virtue to hold in high regard. In the Islamic teachings, Shukr is deemed an essential quality for a believer, encouraging them to remember and thank Allah for His unending kindness and generosity. It serves as a reminder to be mindful of the numerous blessings bestowed upon us and to express our gratitude in both words and actions.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Shukr signifies more than just an expression of gratitude; it represents a deep spiritual connection with Allah. In the Qur'an, verse 7:114 states, "And [remember] when your Lord brought forth from the Children of Adam, from their loins, their descendants and made them test for them [i.e., Adam and his offspring], saying, "I am going to bestow a favor upon you, so remember Me [in prayer and obedience]; but, if you are ungrateful for My favor, I will punish you with a painful punishment."
